items.sentence: Co-linear is two moves with one between, each bringing a prior forward, a line both share, in neither alone, and an abundancing making itself there.
items.text: A wandering spider on a vibrating platform is always turning toward the legs a vibration reaches first, onsets 4 ms apart, or toward the legs it reaches with larger amplitude, amplitudes in the ratio 1 to 3.3; its four legs' weighting factors are 1.2, 0.6, 0.4, 0.4; a vibration reaching a front leg is lowering the factor of the legs behind it on its own side by 0.1, and with vibration reaching both sides this lowering is going front to back alone and is halving the factor; its turning is less exact as the source is further behind it.

Eight legs are three binaries, left or right across, front or back along, and first or not first in sequence, two times two times two being eight: each leg is opening with its prior and the parity it is observing, a leg and its partner across are agreeing or parting now, and the spider's turning is its next, five dimensions resolving in two directions, a vibration coming inward along the legs and the spider's turning going outward, its direction resolving by the sequence of its legs' changing or by the larger amplitude on its legs.

items.sentence: Patterning is co-chaining along, position to position, a sequence a method rides, each pattern a relating already showing that a method co-chains further.
items.text: A desert ant walking out and homing is going by its strides, an odometer adding them up: with stilts on its legs it is overestimating the distance it travels, with stumps for legs it is underestimating it, its stride rate and speed barely changing.

items.section: 1.1 In disequilibria, changing and changing back is a stable-forming method
items.sentence: A self is observing from its own side.
items.text: A hovering hummingbird is holding its place to the millimetre by steadying the visual motion about it; when a background pattern is moving even minimally, it is drifting about a centimetre, and time to adapt is not removing the drifting.

A fruit fly is exploring by straight flights and sudden turns, each turn about 90 degrees in under 50 ms, all or none, left or right; an expanding image is triggering a turn, an attractive odour is changing how often and where turns come, and its halteres, its balance organs, are signalling the counter-turn.

items.sentence: Geodesic goes with a method no force bends, a way it discovers where a forcing way confirms.
items.text: A hunting dragonfly is catching its prey about 95 times in 100, pursuing and snatching in under half a second, its head turning in near-perfect synchrony with the motions that are making the prey's image drift, compensating ahead of any drift, and its body turning in following its head-body angles, most of its turns coming with no change in the prey's motion; the authors' explaining of internal models stands apart from this observing.

items.sentence: A method observes what a sensing returns, valuable and wasteful together, sorting neither.
items.text: An octopus has two out of three of its neurons in its eight arms, and thousands of suckers moving on their own; a sucker's taste cells are signalling continuously but only during direct contact, its touch cells only at a touching's opening, and an arm is tasting semi-independently.

A spider at the centre of its eight legs, a vibration reaching one leg first and the spider turning to it, three binaries drawing eight directions; and a fly's path of straight flights and sudden all-or-none turns, a geodesic snapping.
